summary.text: Patrick Wroblewski is the Democratic candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 72, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business owner born in St. Louis, he says he has served on the Overland City Council since winning election in 2020.

paragraphs.text: Wroblewski attended Christian Brothers College High School and graduated from the University of Missouri, St. Louis, in 2023, and he has also studied at the Harvard Kennedy School.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was raised in Overland, Missouri, in a union-focused family and joined the workforce as a member of the Communication Workers of America (CWA Local 6350) while starting his own business.

Wroblewski said in the survey that he was appointed to Overland's Planning and Zoning Board in 2018, won a City Council seat in 2020 with nearly 70 percent of the vote, was re-elected in 2022, and ran unopposed in 2024.

His stated campaign messages include restoring the middle class with fair wages, affordable health care and tax breaks for working families, and economic development through investment in infrastructure and technology.
